{{Vanilla|Redstone Repeater}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''electric repeater''' is a circuit component that repeats, delays and locks signals. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Redstone Repeater|redstone repeater}} under a new name, and it works the same way.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is the vanilla one, with the renamed ingredients: two [[Electric Inverter|electric inverters]] and an [[Electric Wire|electric wire]] above three [[limestone]].

=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]] sells 64 electric repeaters for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/1/repeater.json}}</ref>
